name: independent-corrections-confirmed
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: The backup's recorded revision during an upgrade checkout
steps.actual: In the upgrade directory, after the article's checkout of the target, git rev-parse HEAD answers 6a8873dbda333fd9992eb77525d4bfa3f47af20d while the backup taken at that moment recorded openlaw-local:d1d098ba9f4ba6557a542857d530446b76b1847c and openlaw-engine-local:d1d098ba9f4ba6557a542857d530446b76b1847c in its images.json. The two provenance files in backups/pre-upgrade therefore disagree, which is what the corrected step 3 now warns about.

steps.action: An occupied port leaves the instance down until the port is corrected
steps.actual: Setting the restored target's PORT to a port another owned project already published made docker compose up -d fail with "Bind for :::43364 failed: port is already allocated", and docker compose ps then listed only doc-engine and postgres. Restoring the intended port and starting again brought app and worker back and /readyz answered 200. This is the sentence added to the port row.

steps.action: A wrong credential key reads as unconfigured email
steps.actual: On the restored target with a different OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY, GET /api/v1/email-settings answered {"source":"unset","fromAddress":null} and the test send failed 502 with the detail "The test email could not be sent. SMTP is not configured — save a relay first.", although the relay was saved and readable under the retained key. Putting the retained key back restored source "app" and real delivery. This is the sentence added to the email section.

note: These three checks re-ran the behaviours behind the corrections made after the walkthroughs, against the corrected article bytes recorded above.
